design_principle: Train d_neg on morphologies using 'not'-derived markers (not, contraction, never, quantifier_no, false_that, fails_to). Test on antonym pairs (NO 'not' token). Strong transfer to antonyms = logical-negation signal. Weak transfer = signal is just 'not' token presence.
confound_control: not_nonneg pairs contain 'not' but NOT as a propositional-negation operator ('not only X but Y', 'not surprisingly...'). A logical-NOT direction should show small activation on these. A 'not-token-detector' direction should show large activation.
